name: How long does it typically take to replace a sliding glass door?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to replace a sliding glass door?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard sliding glass door replacements can be completed within a single day, from removal to installation. However, the total project timeline can extend depending on custom orders, frame modifications, or unforeseen structural issues. Once a door is ordered, manufacturing and delivery can take several weeks. Our team strives for efficient installation to minimize disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard replacement typically takes one day for installation, though custom orders may extend the overall timeline.
